seed_fact: Don't pay 100% upfront. Milestone payments (50/50) protect both you and the designer.
image_headline: Pay Less Risk, Get a Better Site
caption:
Worried about losing money before you see results? Split the cost—pay 50% now and the rest after your site goes live. It protects your budget and guarantees you only pay for a finished, working site. Ready for a risk‑free upgrade? DM me.
